_comment: Dark Tunnel normal spider (content pass C3, plan-content-zones12.md §4): SpiderBite drains what it bites (lifesteal — feeding). Staged LIT at the tunnel's west mouth so players meet spiders in daylight before the dark interior (§2 staging area). curveLevel 4 = the tunnel tier. Drops Antivenom at low chance (the drop pair's lesser source). All values [PLACEHOLDER] ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2d (D4): partial resistances. Before this pass resistances existed ONLY as lock-and-key gates ({"*": 0, "harvest": 1}) — never as mitigation — so every hit in the game landed for full and a damage type meant nothing. These are the curated set that gives the type axis teeth: venomous things are not poisoned easily. Deliberately NON-physical — the C8 tier-threshold guardrail drives its bot with authored Damage at L1, which is physical, so a physical entry here would silently move a calibration this pass has no business moving. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
